from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyFinancialRecord(BaseModel):
    """Extracted financial metric data from a single company's report for the task."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="Name of the company reported in the document")
    report_period: str | None = Field(description="The financial period covered by the report, e.g., Q1 2024")
    metric_label: str | None = Field(description="The line item name as written in the financial statement, e.g., '归属于少数股东的综合收益总额'")
    metric_value: float | None = Field(description="The numeric value reported for the metric; can be negative")
    currency: str | None = Field(description="Currency of the reported value")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_financial_records: list[CompanyFinancialRecord]
